title: A/R Collection: paging keeps each group expanded or collapsed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • More than 30 customers have overdue invoices on today's date; {Customer-A} is on the first page.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-13 First Page.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with only {Customer-A}'s group expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Go to the next page (or scroll until the next 30 load).
  2. Go back to the first page (or scroll back up).
  3. Look at {Customer-A}'s group and the groups around it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the next groups show.
  • Step 2: the first page shows again.
  • Step 3: {Customer-A}'s group is still expanded and the others are still collapsed.

How the next 30 are reached is question 6.
